active_cards: Only transferable method/reference content; no named-compound instructions or parameter/efficacy outcome cards.
originals: Original sources, titles and evidence keep exact identities and hashes. Source examples are evidence, not active reusable compound instructions.
chemistry: Qualified structural moiety, molecular weight, lipophilicity, binding, transport and assay-environment effects may be included; formula alone never establishes applicability.
retrieval: Removed cards absent from cards.json, SQLite, FTS and current modules. Existing stage/source/draft/branch gates remain. No layer auto-promotion.
history: Frozen parent retains old cards/proposals/raw Qwen outputs; parent is not the active index.
